name: 轻型胸甲
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one modular 2D game body.png torso fragment for an existing Spine rig. Image 1 is the edit target: enlarged source torso texture. Image 2 is context ONLY to understand the fragment placement; never generate the complete character. Change only the central blue-gray chest fabric into a small fitted matte steel-blue light breastplate, with a simple warm brass rim and two modest rivets. Keep the original burgundy jacket edges, the angled collar/shoulder silhouette, the diagonal belt and waist hem, and the skin-colored lower attachment junction unchanged. Preserve the source three-quarter left-facing orientation, exact object silhouette and original transparent canvas placement. Follow the colorful soft-outlined cartoon fantasy source style, not photoreal metal, no ornate engravings, no glints, no glow. The large pixels in image 1 are just a magnified low-resolution texture: preserve the clear small-sprite shapes without adding large chunky pixel-art steps. Return ONLY this disconnected torso clothing fragment; no head, no neck extension, no arms/hands/legs, no weapon, no complete person, no display panel. Genuine fully transparent background outside the attachment, no ambient halo or detached flecks, no text. Edit the existing fragment rather than inventing a new costume outline.

normalization.operation: Technical alpha-bound crop, resample and restore original canvas only; no painted edits
